title: Bessent: China's AI Models 'Do Industrial Distillation'
source_used: Real Clear Politics headline; scanx.trade headline; The Next Web / Startup Fortune on the same interview
key_facts: Real Clear Politics posted a video on 4 Oct headlined with Bessent's words: Chinese AI models 'do industrial distillation -- which is a nice word for stealing from the U.S. models'.
scanx.trade (3 Oct) headlines the same claim: Bessent accuses China of stealing US AI models via distillation.
Related coverage says Bessent spoke on The Axios Show on Saturday 3 Oct.
why_it_matters_hint: US Treasury chief publicly accuses Chinese labs of copying US models, no evidence given in what could be read.
notes: RCP page blocked (403), no transcript found. Only headlines support the distillation claim. Probably the Axios interview of 3 Oct, so older than the cutoff.
